name: car-sales-api-fast
description: Simple API server for car sales data (Fastify)

scripts.db:seed: vp run -w db:up && vp run seed
scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --ext ts --exec "vp run build && node --env-file-if-exists=../../docker/local/.env --env-file-if-exists=.env dist/server.js"
scripts.lint: vp run --filter eslint-local-rules-shared build && vp lint . --fix && vp run lint:eslint
scripts.lint:check: vp run --filter eslint-local-rules-shared build && vp lint . && vp run lint:eslint:check
